purpose: Compact source registry for turning references into measured asset dissection records and operator chains.
hard_rules: Prefer sources with explicit dimensions, scales, drawings, field notes, or point-cloud data.
Do not extract geometry from image-only references unless a scale reference is visible and recorded.
Treat treatises as ratio sources, not exact dimension sources.
Treat accessibility and building standards as gameplay scale references, not production compliance claims.
Do not copy protected artwork, drawings, scans, photos, or plates into the repo.
Every extracted measurement must keep source_id, source_url, extraction_method, confidence, and uncertainty note.

sources.why_it_matters: Program source for HABS, HAER, and HALS measured documentation standards and records.
sources.extraction_method: Use individual records and measured drawing sheets only when dimensions or scale references are available.

sources.institution: U.S. National Park Service / Library of Congress
sources.why_it_matters: Collection description identifies measured and interpretive drawings, photographs, written data, and field notes.
sources.extraction_method: Pull dimensions from specific record sheets or written data pages; do not reuse imagery.

sources.why_it_matters: Large public archive of historic architecture, engineering, and landscape documentation.
sources.extraction_method: Use specific record pages with measurements, sheet scales, or written data. Collection landing page is not enough by itself.

sources.source_title: Archive Collections: Plans, Drawings and Documents
sources.why_it_matters: Contains architectural drawings, plans, reports, notes, drawings, and photographs for historic environment records.
sources.extraction_method: Use only records with visible scale, published dimensions, or report text. Otherwise classify as inspiration-only.

sources.why_it_matters: Architectural drawing collection includes sketches, preliminary designs, presentation drawings, and technical drawings.
sources.extraction_method: Use as a candidate source pool; extract only when dimension, scale, or technical drawing context is available.

sources.why_it_matters: Guide for finding architectural drawings and related records across UK archival holdings.
sources.extraction_method: Use as a locator for stronger primary records, not as a direct measurement source.

sources.why_it_matters: Open repository for primary 3D cultural heritage data and scan-derived datasets.
sources.extraction_method: Use point-cloud or mesh-derived measurements only after recording dataset license and processing method.

sources.why_it_matters: CyArk open access program provides cultural heritage point cloud and photogrammetry access through Open Heritage 3D.
sources.extraction_method: Use as scan-source discovery; measurement extraction should happen from the specific hosted dataset.

sources.why_it_matters: Classical source for proportional architectural reasoning and named construction relationships.
sources.extraction_method: Extract ratios and named proportional rules only; do not treat as modern measurement standard.

sources.why_it_matters: Primary record for Palladio's architectural treatise and proportional design language.
sources.extraction_method: Extract reusable ratios and construction relationships; do not copy plates or artwork.

sources.why_it_matters: Gives movement-relevant dimensions and slope constraints useful for gameplay-friendly paths, ramps, thresholds, and landings.
sources.extraction_method: Use as a gameplay/human-scale reference only; do not claim compliance or production approval.
